title: Comparing and bumping versions
description:
Write the version helpers a release script needs, for versions in the form `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` with an optional pre-release part (`1.4.0-rc.2`):

- `parse_version(text)` returns `(major, minor, patch, pre)` where `pre` is a tuple of parts (numbers as `int`, words as `str`), or `()` for none. Anything else raises `ValueError`. Leading zeros like `01` are not allowed.
- `compare(a, b)` returns -1, 0 or 1. A pre-release is lower than the same version without one (`1.0.0-rc.1 < 1.0.0`). Pre-release parts compare one by one: numbers by value, words as text, a number before a word, and fewer parts first when all shared ones are equal.
- `bump(text, part)` with `part` one of `"major"`, `"minor"` or `"patch"` returns the next version as text, dropping any pre-release: `bump("1.4.2", "minor")` is `"1.5.0"`. Bumping the patch of a pre-release gives the release itself: `bump("2.0.0-rc.1", "patch")` is `"2.0.0"`.
hints: One regular expression with `fullmatch` checks the whole shape: three numbers without leading zeros (`0|[1-9]\d*`), then an optional `-` and dot-separated parts.
Compare the `(major, minor, patch)` tuples first; only when they are equal look at the pre-release, where an empty one (a release) is the larger.
